name: St. Jude Children's Research Hospital
summary: Children's research hospital in Memphis, funded mostly by donations raised by its fundraising arm ALSAC: treats children with cancer and other catastrophic diseases free to families, runs one of the largest paediatric cancer research programmes, and supports children's cancer care abroad through St. Jude Global.

programs.label: Patient care, St. Jude Global, training
programs.weight_source: https://www.stjude.org/content/dam/en_US/shared/www/about-st-jude/financial-information/2025%20St.%20Jude%20-%20ALSAC%20combined%20FS%20-%20ADA%20compliant.pdf (FY2025 combined audited accounts, p. 4): patient care $726.65M less net patient service revenue $141.31M (insurers' money) = $585.34M, plus the hospital's education and training (St. Jude Global and training) $146.23M (hospital Form 990 FY2025 total $1,897.57M less patient care, research and hospital administration). Own funds, the spending a donation pays for.

programs.label: Research
programs.weight_source: https://www.stjude.org/content/dam/en_US/shared/www/about-st-jude/financial-information/2025%20St.%20Jude%20-%20ALSAC%20combined%20FS%20-%20ADA%20compliant.pdf (FY2025 combined audited accounts, p. 4): research $883.22M less research grants and contracts $162.43M = $720.79M of St. Jude's own funds. ALSAC's 'public education' ($245.98M of the education, training and community services line) is joint-cost appeal content, counted in both models as fundraising overhead.
